precision: Float64 inputs, nodes, weights and numerical evaluation; cached Gauss roots/weights prepared at 192 bits then rounded once

matching.scheme: CSS with hard factors absorbed into each matching leg
matching.convolution: integral_x^1 dy/y C(x/y)*F(y); fixed Gauss nodes in log(y), optionally split at supplied input knots
matching.inputs: unweighted f, h1, D or KPSY Hhat3; no x or z weight
matching.SIDIS_delta: -2*CF for pdf, transversity, ff and collins
matching.endpoint: ln(v)*plus distribution is regular since ln(1)=0; its delta contribution vanishes; ln(v)/(1-v) has limit -1
matching.leg_product: multiply the two first-order matched legs literally as written in the paper; do not silently truncate the product; historical code comparison remains absent
matching.gluon: required for pdf/ff at nonzero alpha and x<1; absent in transversity/collins matching

fourier.Hhat3: KPSY dimensionful convention, Hhat3=-2*z*M_h*H1perp(1)_Trento; no extra mass factor in Eq74 or Eq109
fourier.interval: explicit finite [0,B] supplied by caller; Gauss nodes exclude b=0; no tail is silently declared zero
fourier.sign: preserve signed transforms; no absolute value or positivity clamp

assembly.matrix_order: rows are explicit PDG flavors; columns are b nodes
assembly.flavors: unique quarks and antiquarks in charge-conjugate pairs, abs(pid)=1..5; gluon enters matching only
assembly.SIDIS: sum_q e_q^2 * matched_pdf_q * matched_ff_q; polarized uses matched_h1_q * matched_Hhat3_q
assembly.SIA: sum over quarks AND antiquarks e_q^2 * matched_FF1_q * matched_FF2_antiquark(q), analogously for Hhat3
assembly.CSS: full perturbative exponent once; channel-specific nonperturbative factor once, under KPSY-CSS-001
assembly.derivatives: Julia generic arithmetic for supplied matched values and gc; kinematics, integration nodes, matching alpha_s and other CSS settings are fixed

limitations: No historical 262-point fit or new physical extraction
Fitted initial parameterizations, scalable many-scale evolution, reviewed bin/acceptance adapters and experimental likelihood admission remain required
Finite integration bounds and low/high-scale input prescriptions require physical refinement and sensitivity checks
No STAR jet kernel, finite-R matching, production derivative/performance gate or interval-coverage certification
Analytic component comparisons and reconstructed input checks cannot authorize production
